lines: Midnight. Inside the vault there is no gold. Just one small, glowing *clock*... stopped at twelve.
Vex whispers: it is the world's clock. Hold it still, and time stays frozen *forever*. No more tomorrow. No more aging.
You think of Bea. Of birthdays. Of cold coffee and rainy Mondays. You turn the dial... and *press play*.
The city wakes up. Cars honk. Pigeons fly. Vex smiles, and fades out like a shadow. Bea hands you a small gift.
It is a watch. But why is its second hand... *not moving*?
Follow for the next story... and comment what it should be!
